content: Capital Structure tradeoff(Equity - Debt, advantages and

Analysis(indifference point, financial break even point), Ratio

structure

Decision, Issues in dividend policy, Bonus Share & Stock Splits

Dividend Policy - Walter’s Model, Gordon’s Model, The Miller and
Modigilani (MM) Hypothesis and the concept of Dividend and
Uncertainty - the bird in the hand argument
Introduction, Terms of payment, Credit policy Variables, Credit
Evaluation, Credit Granting Decision, Control of Accounts
Receivables, Credit Management in India
